checks.title: Premium SKU for governance and security controls
checks.reason: Observed ARM SKU of the workspace. Observed configuration; it doesn't prove runtime effectiveness.
checks.business_impact: A tier below Premium can limit identity controls, Unity Catalog and access isolation.
checks.recommendation: Confirm the Premium tier for production workloads that need Unity Catalog, role-based access control and advanced auditing.

checks.title: Secure cluster connectivity (no public IP)
checks.reason: enableNoPublicIp parameter observed in ARM.
checks.business_impact: Cluster nodes with public IP addresses increase the network exposure of the data plane.
checks.recommendation: Enable enableNoPublicIp on the workspace so compute nodes have no public IP addresses and reach the control plane through an outbound relay.

checks.title: VNet injection into a customer-managed network
checks.reason: customVirtualNetworkId parameter and host/container subnet injection. Observed configuration; it doesn't prove runtime effectiveness.
checks.business_impact: The default managed VNet prevents custom routes, egress inspection and granular peering.
checks.recommendation: When the corporate network architecture requires it, deploy the workspace with customVirtualNetworkId and dedicated host and container subnets.

checks.title: Public network restriction and Private Link for the workspace
checks.reason: publicNetworkAccess, requiredNsgRules and private endpoint configuration. Observed configuration; it doesn't prove runtime effectiveness.
checks.business_impact: Open public access without compensating controls widens the entry surface of the workspace.
checks.recommendation: Review publicNetworkAccess, requiredNsgRules and the approved private endpoint connections against your private isolation requirements.

checks.title: Access connector with managed identity and storage firewall
checks.reason: Access connector linked to the workspace for managed identity.
checks.business_impact: Without an access connector, the workspace can't use a managed identity to authenticate to governed storage.
checks.recommendation: Link an Azure Databricks access connector with a managed identity (SystemAssigned or UserAssigned) and review defaultStorageFirewall.

checks.title: Customer-managed key (CMK) and infrastructure encryption
checks.reason: The confirmed requirement doesn't apply. CMK encryption of managedServices and managedDisk.
checks.business_impact: Without CMK where regulation requires it, the customer doesn't directly control cryptographic revocation.
checks.recommendation: If your compliance policy requires CMK, configure Key Vault keys for managedServices and managedDisk with automatic rotation.

checks.title: Enhanced security profile and automatic cluster update
checks.reason: The confirmed requirement doesn't apply. Observed enhancedSecurityCompliance profile.
checks.business_impact: Without automatic updates or the required enhanced monitoring, agent maintenance depends on manual processes.
checks.recommendation: Evaluate enhancedSecurityMonitoring, automaticClusterUpdate and complianceSecurityProfile when specific regulations apply.

checks.title: Diagnostic settings on the ARM control plane
checks.reason: Diagnostic settings enabled in ARM; actual ingestion needs separate verification.
checks.business_impact: Without diagnostic logs, control-plane, job and access events are harder to trace.
checks.recommendation: Send audit categories through Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings to Log Analytics, Storage or Event Hubs and verify the ingestion.

checks.title: Personal access token (PAT) governance in workspace-conf
checks.reason: PAT token governance (enableTokensConfig and maxTokenLifetimeDays <= 90 days).
checks.business_impact: Personal tokens without issuance or expiry control increase the risk of persistent credentials.
checks.recommendation: Review enableTokensConfig and prefer OAuth M2M authentication or Microsoft Entra managed identities over long-lived PATs.

checks.title: Unity Catalog as the default catalog instead of legacy Hive
checks.reason: Observed UnityCatalog default catalog or attached metastore.
checks.business_impact: Using hive_metastore and the DBFS root makes unified access control and data lineage harder.
checks.recommendation: Set UnityCatalog as the default catalog and avoid storing business data in the DBFS root or hive_metastore.

checks.title: Global init script hygiene and review
checks.reason: Enabled global init scripts should be minimized and moved to policies or governed volumes.
checks.business_impact: Global init scripts run on every cluster in the workspace and can introduce hidden dependencies or points of failure.
checks.recommendation: Minimize or audit the enabled global init scripts and prefer cluster policies or init scripts stored in Unity Catalog volumes.

checks.title: Review of cached Azure Advisor recommendations
checks.reason: Cached Azure Advisor recommendations read for the workspace.
checks.business_impact: Ignoring platform alerts can delay finding reliability or cost improvements.
checks.recommendation: Check the cached Azure Advisor recommendations for the workspace and its associated resources as a complementary input.

checks.recommendation: Set autotermination_minutes (for example 60 minutes or less) on every all-purpose cluster to avoid idle DBU and VM consumption.

checks.recommendation: If you need runtime lineage at table or column level, enable and query system.access.table_lineage in an authorized session; this collector never starts compute to do it.

checks.business_impact: Allowing unencrypted traffic or anonymous container access exposes lakehouse assets.
checks.recommendation: Require supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true, minimumTlsVersion=TLS1_2 and allowBlobPublicAccess=false on the associated ADLS Gen2 accounts.

checks.business_impact: Account shared keys bypass the granular identity controls of Microsoft Entra and Unity Catalog.
checks.recommendation: Evaluate disabling allowSharedKeyAccess and restricting publicNetworkAccess on ADLS Gen2 accounts governed by Microsoft Entra ID / Unity Catalog.

checks.title: RBAC authorization and purge protection on associated key vaults
checks.reason: No associated ARM resources of this type were collected in the approved scope; no absence of risk is assumed.
checks.business_impact: Without purge protection, accidental or malicious deletion of a CMK key or secret can be irreversible.
checks.recommendation: Enable enableRbacAuthorization and enablePurgeProtection on the key vaults linked to secret scopes or to the workspace CMK keys.

checks.title: Administrative ports exposed to the internet on associated NSGs
checks.reason: No associated ARM resources of this type were collected in the approved scope; no absence of risk is assumed.
checks.business_impact: Inbound rules open to the internet on cluster subnets break data-plane isolation.
checks.recommendation: Remove or restrict inbound Allow rules from the internet (0.0.0.0/0, *, Internet) to SSH (22), RDP (3389) or all ports on the workspace subnets.

checks.title: Approved state on associated private endpoint connections
checks.reason: No associated ARM resources of this type were collected in the approved scope; no absence of risk is assumed.
checks.business_impact: A private endpoint in the Pending, Rejected or Disconnected state breaks the intended private connectivity.
checks.recommendation: Confirm that every private endpoint connection associated with the workspace or its linked resources is in the Approved state.

catalogSnapshot.name: Azure Databricks Well-Architected & Lakehouse Dependency Review

interpretation: Local rule-resource indicators, not an official Microsoft Well-Architected assessment, certification or Databricks audit grade.
Dependency edges distinguish OBSERVED native ID/key joins from explicit INFERRED URI/host references and UNKNOWN runtime lineage.

Control-plane REST API reads never start clusters or SQL warehouses and never execute billable SQL queries against system.access.table_lineage; system.billing.usage is queried only when the operator sets system_tables_warehouse_id (off by default; that one fixed statement consumes DBUs and can start the chosen warehouse).
Cross-tenant collection requires explicit administrator-configured federation or Azure Lighthouse delegation; a single-tenant SRE UAMI never acquires foreign-tenant tokens implicitly.
Configuration presence does not prove effective firewall enforcement, data-plane network reachability, least-privilege Unity Catalog grants or workload SLA compliance.
limitations: Point-in-time ARM control-plane and Databricks Workspace/Unity Catalog REST metadata assessment; no cluster or SQL Warehouse is started.
Dependency edges are classified strictly as OBSERVED (exact native ID/key join), INFERRED (unverified URI/hostname target) or UNKNOWN (uncollected runtime lineage or code internals).
Cross-tenant execution requires prior administrator setup (multi-tenant app with Federated Identity Credential or Azure Lighthouse + Databricks OIDC federation).
This local indicator is not an official Microsoft Well-Architected Review or Databricks certification.
